summary: Waldencast plc filed a 6-K reporting the sale of its Obagi business (medical-grade skincare) to Waypoint Bidco, LLC (backed by Bridgepoint and Gore Range Capital) for up to $460M consideration. Terms include $366M cash (subject to customary adjustments), $30M in vendor notes, and up to $64M in earnouts based on 2026-2027 revenue milestones. The transaction involves a merger of Obagi Cosmeceuticals with two merger subs. No specific board recommendation or advisors named. Closing subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions; no financing contingency. Risk-arb: monitor regulatory clearance and earnout achievement timelines.
